search.needKeysBody: The shared server keys are only for the first users. To search and add new entries, enter your own key in your profile.
search.adultBlocked: Adult content is hidden. You can enable it in your profile.

visibilityHint.PUBLIC: You and your confirmed friends can see it. Visitors cannot.
visibilityHint.UNLISTED: Only you can see it. This is the old “Link only” setting; it works like “Only me”.

profile.title: Profile
profile.sharedInfo: The first {limit} users may use the shared server keys. Want to use your own? Enter them below (optional).
profile.requiredInfo: You are user #{number} (after the first {limit}). To add new movies/games from the databases you MUST enter your own API keys below.
profile.emptyHint: Leave a field empty — the value will not change. Keys are visible only to you.
profile.langHint: Choose the interface language. New imports fetch descriptions in this language too. You can switch it any time in the top bar.
profile.themeHint: Pick a colour theme for the whole portal. Applies instantly and is saved for next time.
profile.adultHint: Off by default: adult content is hidden in search and refused on import. Turn on at your own risk.
profile.refreshAllHint: Older entries were saved in a single language. This re-fetches every imported movie / series / game from the source and fills in all three languages, so switching language re-labels them instantly. May take a while for large libraries.
profile.clearKeysConfirm: Remove all your API keys? Search will fall back to the shared server keys. If you are user #21 or later, you will not be able to add new items from TMDB and IGDB until you enter keys again.

about.title: A personal diary of movies, series and games
about.lead: Media Diary started as a Google Sheets table where I noted what I had watched and played. Now it is a website: log what you watch or play, rate it, write down your thoughts and choose who sees it – everyone, friends only or just you.
about.whoText: Konrad Lorenz, a computer science student at Vytautas Magnus University. I build it for myself and my friends in my free time. It is not a company or a commercial product.
about.dataIntro: Only what the diary needs is stored. Everything is kept on my own server (Oracle Cloud).
about.rowNameWhy: Login via Authentik; your name is shown to friends
about.rowNameWho: You, your friends (name only), the administrator
about.rowItemsWho: As you choose for each entry
about.rowCodeWhy: So a friend can add you
about.rowKeysWhy: Searching TMDB and IGDB with your key
about.rowKeysWho: Only you; stored encrypted in the database
about.rowCookiesWhy: Login session, chosen language (NEXT_LOCALE) and colour theme (theme)
about.rowCookiesWho: Only your browser and this site
about.noTracking: No ads, analytics or tracking cookies. Your data is not sold or shared.
about.posters: Posters are loaded directly from TMDB's server, so TMDB can see they were downloaded (but not your name).
about.deletion: Want your account and all entries deleted? Write via the feedback form or by e-mail.
about.sourcesTitle: Where descriptions and posters come from
about.sourcesIntro: Titles, descriptions and images are fetched from two open databases. Your ratings and thoughts stay here and are not sent to them.
about.tmdbNotice: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
about.contactText: Found a bug, have an idea or a question about your data? The quickest way is the form – it reaches me directly.

feedbackAdmin.title: Feedback
feedbackAdmin.intro: All messages received via the form, newest first. Mark what you have read and resolved.
